title: Three.js
summary: 3D in the theme colors, drawn with glowing edges and points rather than lit surfaces: wireframe solids, plus shader scenes with their own glow pass, depth and camera moves.
usage: {"piece": "three/wire-globe"}; explainers take data: {"piece": "three/data-bars", "props": {"items": [{"label": "A", "value": 3}]}}. Files: library/themes/futuristic/three/pieces/ (_fx.js is the shared glow stage and shader kit, not a piece).

items.name: Wire globe
items.description: A rotating wireframe globe with lit nodes and orbit rings.

items.name: Data core
items.description: Nested wireframe solids turning around a bright core.

items.name: Grid run
items.description: An endless floor grid rushing to the horizon.

items.name: Hologram knot
items.description: A hologram of a knotted form prints itself above an emitter, then turns with rim light, scanlines and glitch slices: the prototype, the model, new tech.

items.name: Particle morph
items.description: 26,000 points flow from sphere to cube to torus to wave sheet and back (loop): transformation, data taking shape.

items.name: Plasma orb
items.description: A living orb whose noise-driven surface glows in contour lines, with a halo and orbiting sparks: energy, the AI, the core idea.

items.name: DNA helix
items.description: A double helix of points grows, turns and pulses, with depth-of-field blur: biology, the code of life, what it is made of.

items.name: Neural net
items.description: Layers of ring nodes with waves of signal running down the connections: AI, learning, how the model decides.

items.name: Net globe
items.description: A point-cloud planet (abstract land shapes) with an atmosphere rim and comets arcing between hubs: global, the network, traffic.

items.name: Voxel cube
items.description: Hundreds of voxels fly in and lock into a cube, get scanned, then its layers twist: storage, the dataset, building blocks.

items.name: Hex shield
items.description: A dome of hexagonal cells rises over a core and takes hits that ripple across it: security, protection, blocked.

items.name: Event horizon
items.description: A black hole with a swirling particle disk whose far side bends over the shadow (loop): gravity, the pull, no way back.

items.name: Circuit pulse
items.description: Traces route themselves out from a chip and carry pulses of current to their pads: hardware, processing, power on.

items.name: Sonic rings
items.description: Concentric rings rippling as a 3D spectrum around a pulsing core (loop): audio, voice, signal, frequency.

items.name: Neon terrain
items.description: A low flight down a valley of wireframe mountains toward a slotted sun (loop): the future, the journey, a title bed.

items.name: Warp tunnel
items.description: Light streaks and hexagonal gates rushing past at hyperspeed (loop): speed, acceleration, the jump.

items.name: Wire city
items.description: A flight down the avenue of a wireframe city with lit windows (loop): the city, the market, infrastructure, scale.

items.name: Data rain
items.description: Columns of glyphs falling through depth with bright heads and fading tails (loop): data, code, the system underneath.

items.name: Data bars
items.description: A 3D bar chart on a mirrored floor: bars rise and count up, the largest in amber. Props: items [{label, value}], unit, highlight, note.

items.name: Node map
items.description: A labelled hub-and-spoke network that draws itself, then carries signals both ways. Props: center, nodes [label, ...].

items.name: Geo arcs
items.description: A lattice globe with named places at real coordinates and routes arcing between them. Props: points [{name, lat, lon}], routes [[from, to], ...].

items.name: Layer stack
items.description: A stack that assembles one numbered, named layer at a time, then streams light through. Props: layers [label, ...] bottom first.
